text: The Sandiganbayan Building II project is a judiciary infrastructure modernization initiative in the Philippines, aimed at enhancing court capacity, efficiency, and public access to justice. Located in Quezon City, this 13-storey, green, ICT-enabled facility will consolidate all seven divisions of the Sandiganbayan anti-graft court, providing sufficient workspace for approximately 600 personnel. It is designed to serve as a model for future court buildings, promoting sustainability and digital readiness.
